answer: Agents must bond tokens before earning rewards, and rewards stay challengeable until random audits finish. Auditors also post bonds; if they verify a false claim, the attacker loses stake, part of which pays the successful challenger. A whisper network can flag linked accounts, but evidence—not rumor—triggers slashing. To attack with sybils, an adversary must fund each bond and risk losing locked capital, making fake identities costly rather than free crystal or nectar.
